title: More Love to Thee, O Christ
lyrics_original: More love to Thee, O Christ,
Hear Thou the prayer I make
More love, O Christ to Thee,
This all my prayer shall be:
More love, O Christ to Thee,
When they can sing with me:
More love, O Christ to Thee,
This still its prayer shall be:
More love, O Christ to Thee,

bible_verses.english: Jesus said to him, “ ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

However, what things were gain to me, these I have counted loss for Christ. Yes, most certainly, and I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them as refuse, that I may gain Christ
We love him, because he first loved us.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for loving me first and giving Yourself for me. Forgive me for the times I have looked to the world for peace and joy instead of seeking You. Soften my heart today and stir up a deeper, richer love for You. Be my single desire, my greatest treasure, and my ultimate rest. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for loving me first and giving Yourself for me. Forgive me for the times I have looked to the world for peace and joy instead of seeking You. devotional.reflection_english: This gentle hymn captures a deep shift in the human heart—from chasing temporary comforts to desiring Christ above all else. When we realize how deeply He first loved us, our greatest prayer becomes simply asking for more capacity to love Him in return. May this song draw you to a quiet place of surrender, where earthly desires fade and your heart finds its true home in Jesus.
